brand.name: KG Realty Group
brand.audience: Home buyers, sellers, and investors in Chino Hills and Southern California
brand.positioning: Experienced, personal representation with the polish and confidence of a premium real estate brand

source.type: Approximate visual interpretation of the supplied Kevin Gonzalez banner
source.note: These colors are design estimates, not verified official brand specifications.

identity.visualIdea: A precise KG monogram and architectural diagonal framing that suggest a considered path into a home.

logoUsage.primary: Use the supplied KG Realty Group artwork without redrawing, distorting, or recoloring it.
logoUsage.clearSpace: Keep at least the height of the K monogram clear on every side.
logoUsage.minimumSize: Use the full wordmark only when KG Realty Group remains readable; switch to approved monogram artwork at smaller sizes.
logoUsage.backgrounds: Prefer charcoal or white backgrounds with sufficient contrast. Do not place gold artwork on a busy photograph.
logoUsage.brokerage: Keep eXp Realty attribution legible and visually distinct from the KG Realty Group wordmark.

motifs: Clean rules and generous negative space

palette.sourceNote: Hex values are approximations informed by the supplied banner and tuned for practical interface use.

ink.role: Primary dark background, footer, and high-emphasis text

charcoal.role: Secondary dark surface, overlays, and navigation details

gold.role: Brand accent for large marks, rules, selected states, and decorative details

goldLight.role: Gold highlight and accent text on dark backgrounds

goldDeep.role: Accessible gold-toned text and icons on light backgrounds

paper.role: Warm neutral page or section background

white.role: Primary content surface and text on dark backgrounds

border.role: Subtle dividers, input borders, and card outlines

danger.role: Error and destructive state only; not a brand accent

usage.darkSections: Use ink or charcoal with white text; reserve gold for prominent accents and identity details.
usage.contentSections: Use white or paper backgrounds with ink text and mutedText for secondary copy.
usage.primaryActions: On light surfaces, use an ink button with goldLight text or an accessible goldDeep accent treatment. On dark surfaces, use gold with ink text.
usage.goldContrast: Do not use gold or goldLight as small text on white. Use goldDeep on light backgrounds and goldLight on dark backgrounds.
usage.functionalColors: Keep success, warning, and danger reserved for their interface meanings.

display.usage: Headlines, navigation, prices, and short uppercase labels

body.usage: Paragraphs, forms, listing details, and supporting interface text

wordmark.family: Use the supplied logo artwork; do not substitute a typeface for the logo

principles: Use clear scale contrast and compact, deliberate line lengths.
Keep body copy highly readable and avoid overusing uppercase tracking.
Use gold typography sparingly and only where the background provides sufficient contrast.

surfaces.identity: Ink or charcoal for the footer, selected brand bands, and high-impact identity moments.
surfaces.content: White or paper for search, listings, profiles, forms, and long-form content.
surfaces.cards: Use restrained borders and shadows; keep property photography as the focal point.

components.navigation: Light and quiet by default, with charcoal text and gold or goldDeep active accents.
components.primaryAction: High-contrast ink-and-gold treatment; avoid low-contrast gold text on white.
components.secondaryAction: Outlined or text action using ink, with gold reserved for hover or active emphasis.
components.forms: White fields, clear neutral borders, ink text, and a visible gold or charcoal focus ring.
components.listingStatus: Use neutral or functional status treatments; do not use the brand accent to imply success or danger.

interface.shape: Square-cornered or subtly rounded controls; avoid excessive pill shapes.
interface.depth: Use small, soft shadows only when needed to distinguish interactive surfaces.

subjects: Architectural homes and interiors in Southern California
Kevin Gonzalez and the team in authentic, professional portraits
Neighborhood details that identify local communities
imagery.treatment: Natural warm light, crisp architectural detail, editorial crops, and restrained charcoal overlays where text is placed over photography.
avoid: Heavy gold filters or artificial metallic effects
Busy backgrounds behind logos or essential text

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA contrast for text and essential interface controls. Verify final pairings in the rendered site.
accessibility.focus: Provide a clearly visible keyboard focus indicator on every interactive element.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for transitions and scroll behavior.
accessibility.colorMeaning: Do not communicate listing status, errors, or success through color alone.

implementation.fontFamilies: Matches the current Plus Jakarta Sans and Montserrat theme families.
implementation.migration: Replace legacy red brand accents with semantic ink and gold tokens in component styles; preserve red only where it carries a genuine functional meaning.
